scope: Complete retail bodies without injected calls or arithmetic. Native integer binary32 scalar add/subtract, finite normal/signed zero, DN=1, RM0/1, both banks, cancellation and rounding, identical/partially overlapping source/destination buffers. All registers/SR/PR/FPU/FPUL/RAM compared against unhooked retail instruction execution. PR=SZ=0; NaN/Infinity and enabled exception trap paths outside current verification scope.
